messages.text:
"Make a mobile touch 2D top-down dinosaur survival game, Durango-style.

- Left virtual joystick to move, right-side buttons to attack / gather / interact
- Health, hunger, and thirst bars at the top of the screen. They drain over time, and when hunger or thirst hits 0, health drains continuously
- The map has rivers/lakes (drink water), berry trees (food), and resources like trees and rocks
- Wild dinosaurs (Triceratops, Raptor, T-Rex) roam around; hunting them drops meat
- Day/night cycle
- Show short tutorial text when the game starts

Finish this basic gameplay first.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
